full_details: In the morning the ladies were in the park on the page, and you still had no sentence for them. At eleven you stood at the mouth of the close, a hundred yards from the porch, among citizens' backs. The Prince of Purpoole's mock-court rode up to Crosby Place under torch-smoke. Sir John Spencer, a furred gown on the steps, received a law-student king with a straight face, and did not speak to you. Mistress Ansell said he will dine a play-prince at his table and shut the door on a player, and that that is the City. You and Burbage laughed over the Night of Errors. Burbage looked at how the king sat a hired horse. You did not go in. You walked down to the Cross Keys. The gentlemen who had your Errors on Innocents' night keep a better court than Navarre's. Two Gentlemen played, and you were not in it. You wrote one line of Berowne in the parlour. At the reckoning the gallery was not all in. Heminges would not give a figure, and would not strike a share, because Monday still plays. Burbage repeated her sentence. Kemp kept it. At home you lined four payments on the right-hand side: Wednesday's board, the Split Hazel, Friday's board, firing and washing. You did not open a new count.
one_sentence: You stood among the backs at Crosby Place and came home with four payments lined.
title: Stood at Crosby Place and lined four payments
